copy.headline: Arlington police searching for Quimari WILLIAMS, wanted for aggravated assault with a deadly weapon
copy.caption:
Arlington police are looking for Quimari WILLIAMS, wanted for aggravated assault with a deadly weapon. Crime Stoppers is offering up to $2,000 for information leading to an arrest.

Call 817-469-TIPS (8477) or submit a tip at 469tips.com. You stay anonymous.
